metadata.density_source: FAO/INFOODS Density Database v2.0 + USDA FDC volume-to-weight conversions

avocado.preparation_notes: Raw peeled and pitted avocado flesh (0.5 medium avocado), plain without dressing.
avocado.density_source: USDA FDC 171705 volume-to-weight (1 cup pureed = 230 g / 236.59 cm3 = 0.972 g/cm3).

bacon.preparation_notes: Cured pork bacon, baked/pan-cooked until crisp and drained (3 slices at 8.1 g).
bacon.density_source: Food engineering estimate for plated crisp cured pork strips (FAO raw pork medium = 0.93 g/mL).

baked_beans.usda_description: Beans, baked, canned, plain or vegetarian
baked_beans.preparation_notes: Canned vegetarian/plain baked beans in tomato-sugar sauce, heated (0.5 cup).
baked_beans.density_source: USDA FDC 175182 volume-to-weight (1 cup = 254 g / 236.59 cm3 = 1.074 g/cm3).

baked_potato.usda_description: Potatoes, baked, flesh and skin, without salt
baked_potato.preparation_notes: Whole medium baked potato (flesh and skin), plain without added butter, sour cream, or salt.
baked_potato.density_source: Whole cooked potato tuber density estimate (~1.05 g/cm3; FAO boiled cubed bulk = 0.59 g/mL).

broccoli.usda_description: Broccoli, cooked, boiled, drained, without salt
broccoli.preparation_notes: Cooked/steamed/boiled broccoli florets, drained, without added butter or oil (1 cup chopped).
broccoli.density_source: Project benchmark / USDA FDC 169967 florets bulk density (~0.60 g/cm3; chopped 1 cup = 156 g / 236.59 cm3 = 0.659).

cabbage.preparation_notes: Raw chopped or shredded cabbage without heavy mayonnaise/oil dressing (1 cup chopped).
cabbage.density_source: USDA FDC 169975 volume-to-weight (1 cup chopped raw = 89 g / 236.59 cm3 = 0.376 g/cm3).

carrot.preparation_notes: Raw sliced, shredded, or stick carrots, plain without glaze or butter (1 cup strips/slices).
carrot.density_source: FAO/INFOODS v2.0 ('Carrot, raw, chopped' = 0.54 g/mL, KEN; matches USDA 128 g/cup = 0.541 g/cm3).

cheese_burger.usda_description: Fast foods, cheeseburger; single, regular patty, with condiments
cheese_burger.preparation_notes: Single grilled beef patty with cheese on white bun with standard condiments (1 regular burger).
cheese_burger.density_source: Composite assembly estimate (aerated bun ~0.29 g/cm3 + beef/cheese ~1.0 g/cm3; 127 g / ~280 cm3).

chicken_breast.usda_description: Chicken, broilers or fryers, breast, meat only, cooked, roasted
chicken_breast.preparation_notes: Boneless, skinless chicken breast, roasted or grilled without breading or heavy oil (~5 oz cooked).
chicken_breast.density_source: Project benchmark / solid cooked poultry tissue density (~1.05 g/cm3; FAO poultry mixture = 1.038 g/mL).

chicken_tender.preparation_notes: Breaded and deep-fried chicken breast tenderloin strips, without dipping sauce (4 strips at 30 g).
chicken_tender.density_source: Plated breaded fried poultry estimate (meat core ~1.05 g/cm3 + crispy porous breading).

chicken_thigh.usda_description: Chicken, broilers or fryers, thigh, meat and skin, cooked, roasted
chicken_thigh.preparation_notes: Roasted/baked chicken thigh, meat and skin included, unbreaded (1 thigh).
chicken_thigh.density_source: Solid cooked poultry dark-meat tissue with skin (~1.02 g/cm3; slightly lower than lean breast 1.05).

chips.preparation_notes: Fried/baked crispy salted snack chips (potato/tortilla chips), served dry (1 oz / ~22 chips).

french_fries.usda_description: Fast foods, potato, french fried in vegetable oil
french_fries.preparation_notes: Deep-fried potato strips in vegetable oil, salted, without cheese or chili toppings (1 medium serving).
french_fries.density_source: Bulk piled fried potato strips estimate (inter-piece air voids; ~0.40-0.50 g/cm3).

fried_egg.preparation_notes: Whole large chicken egg pan-fried in minimal cooking fat/oil (1 large egg).
fried_egg.density_source: Whole flat cooked egg on plate (yolk/albumen tissue ~1.03 g/cm3; FAO 0.60 is chopped cup bulk).

fried_rice.usda_description: Restaurant, Chinese, fried rice, without meat
fried_rice.preparation_notes: Stir-fried cooked white rice with oil, soy sauce, egg, and aromatics without extra meat (1 cup).
fried_rice.density_source: FAO/INFOODS v2.0 ('Rice, boiled with fat' = 0.70 g/mL, KEN).

green_beans.usda_description: Beans, snap, green, cooked, boiled, drained, without salt
green_beans.preparation_notes: Boiled or steamed whole/cut green snap beans, drained, without butter or bacon (1 cup).
green_beans.density_source: FAO/INFOODS v2.0 ('French green beans' = 0.53 g/mL, KEN; matches USDA 125 g/cup = 0.528 g/cm3).

hash_brown.preparation_notes: Pan-fried/griddled shredded potato hash browns or fried potato patty in oil (1 restaurant serving).
hash_brown.density_source: Midpoint of USDA FDC 169848 loose shredded (94 g/cup = 0.40 g/cm3) and pan-fried patty (~0.63 g/cm3).

mashed_potatoes.usda_description: Potatoes, mashed, home-prepared, whole milk and butter added
mashed_potatoes.preparation_notes: Home-style boiled potatoes mashed with whole milk and butter, without extra gravy (1 cup).
mashed_potatoes.density_source: USDA FDC 168555 volume-to-weight (1 cup = 210 g / 236.59 cm3 = 0.888 g/cm3).

meat_loaf.usda_description: Beef, ground, 85% lean meat / 15% fat, loaf, cooked, baked
meat_loaf.preparation_notes: Baked 85% lean ground beef loaf, sliced, without extra brown gravy (1 slice ~5 oz).
meat_loaf.density_source: Solid baked ground beef loaf estimate (~0.98 g/cm3; slightly below intact steak 1.05).

pancake.preparation_notes: Plain griddled buttermilk/egg batter pancakes, excluding syrup and butter (2 x 6" pancakes at 77 g).
pancake.density_source: Aerated griddled cake estimate (77 g / ~160 cm3 per 6" pancake).

pasta.usda_description: Pasta, cooked, enriched, without added salt
pasta.preparation_notes: Boiled enriched wheat pasta (spaghetti/penne/macaroni), drained, excluding heavy sauces (1 cup).
pasta.density_source: FAO/INFOODS v2.0 ('Pasta/ noodles, boiled' = 0.59 g/mL, KEN).

pizza.usda_description: Fast Food, Pizza Chain, 14" pizza, cheese topping, regular crust
pizza.preparation_notes: Baked regular-crust cheese pizza with tomato sauce and mozzarella (1 slice, 1/8 of 14" pie).
pizza.density_source: Composite baked crust + cheese/sauce slice estimate (107 g / ~178 cm3).

pork_chop.usda_description: Pork, fresh, loin, center loin (chops), bone-in, separable lean and fat, cooked, broiled
pork_chop.preparation_notes: Broiled or grilled center-loin pork chop, unbreaded, lean and fat included (1 chop edible portion).
pork_chop.density_source: Solid cooked pork loin muscle + fat tissue estimate (~1.03 g/cm3; FAO raw pork medium = 0.93 g/mL).

shrimp.usda_description: Crustaceans, shrimp, mixed species, cooked, moist heat (may contain additives to retain moisture)
shrimp.preparation_notes: Boiled, steamed, or lightly sauteed peeled shrimp without breading or batter (3 oz cooked).
shrimp.density_source: FAO/INFOODS v2.0 ('Prawns, whole, boiled, without shell' = 0.77 g/mL, RC).

steak.usda_description: Beef, loin, top loin steak, boneless, lip off, separable lean and fat, trimmed to 0" fat, select, cooked, grilled
steak.preparation_notes: Grilled boneless beef top loin steak, trimmed, without compound butter or cream sauce (1 steak).
steak.density_source: Solid cooked beef muscle tissue density (~1.05 g/cm3; FAO raw lean beef = 0.96 g/mL).

waffle.preparation_notes: Plain batter waffle baked in waffle iron, excluding syrup, whipped cream, and butter (1 round 7" waffle).
waffle.density_source: Aerated gridded batter envelope estimate (75 g / ~215 cm3 including waffle pockets).

white_rice.usda_description: Rice, white, long-grain, regular, enriched, cooked
white_rice.preparation_notes: Steamed or boiled plain long-grain white rice, without added oil or butter (1 cup cooked).
white_rice.density_source: Project benchmark for plated cooked white rice (FAO/INFOODS v2.0 loose 'Rice, white, boiled' = 0.73 g/mL, RC).

yeast_bread.usda_description: Bread, white, commercially prepared (includes soft bread crumbs)
yeast_bread.preparation_notes: Commercially prepared sliced white yeast bread, plain without butter or spreads (1 regular slice).
yeast_bread.density_source: FAO/INFOODS v2.0 ('Bread, white, sliced, prepacked' = 0.29 g/mL, FNDDS 4.1).
